judged.play: 100 Thieves wins the final round in overtime to secure the match victory

judged.play: Post-match broadcast shows 100T celebrating while the opposing crowd is quiet
judged.line: Look how silent the crowd is, oh my god!

judged.play: 100T players walk onto the stage towards the trophy

judged.line: We waited for times like these!
judged.reason: The quintessential trophy lift moment with full streamer hype and confetti, standing out as a main storyline climax.
